tools.name: racket_check
tools.description: Full Racket Check of a local service provider's website URL. Fetches the homepage plus the pricing, services, plans and terms pages it links to (same host, capped) and scores racket signals: subscription / plan / membership language, minimum-visit or package requirements, contract lock-in language (

tools.name: racket_check_lite
tools.description: FREE lite Racket Check of a local service provider's website URL. Runs the same scan as racket_check but returns the verdict (CLEAN / PLAN_PUSH / RACKET / UNKNOWN) and the 0-100 score only — no evidence snippets, no signal detail. Use this to triage whether a provider deserves the full racket_check
